## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor its required environment default because CI-provided exclusions currently have no effect. This review read the tests without running them.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` filtering by filename, skip logging, flag documentation, and tests for parsing and archive contents.

(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read --exclude defaults from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you still archive `.log` files because `default=[]` ignores the environment. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11). — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the environment include files they explicitly intended to omit.
